tasks.subject: Task 0: Detect the hot IDWT variant
tasks.description:
USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.

**Goal:** Determine whether the live stream decodes via dwt_extrapolate::decode (reduce-extrapolate) or dwt::decode (legacy), so we vectorize the path that actually runs.

**Files:** progressive.rs (temp probe), session/src/egfx_decoder.rs (one-shot web_sys log).

**Acceptance Criteria:** console prints [idwt-variant] extrapolate|legacy during playback; probe removed before commit; variant recorded in Task 2.

**Verify:** ./build-release-wasm.sh debug → reload with video → await L.distinct('[idwt-variant]').

tasks.subject: Task 1: I32x4 lane abstraction (simd_lane.rs)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Portable 4-lane i32 type with v128 + scalar cfg backends, IDWT ops, host unit tests.

**Files:** create simd_lane.rs; modify lib.rs (mod simd_lane).

**Acceptance Criteria:** I32x4 compiles wasm32+simd128 and host; lane tests pass (wrap_i16, sra, shl, div2_trunc, from_lanes/to_array); div2_trunc matches Rust /2 for negatives.

**Verify:** cargo test -p session --lib simd_lane.


tasks.subject: Task 2: Diff-test + decode_simd for the hot variant
tasks.description:
**Goal:** SIMD inverse-DWT for the Task-0 variant, max|delta|==0 vs scalar decode over real coefficient buffers.

Detected hot variant (Task 0, 2026-06-17): EXTRAPOLATE → port dwt_extrapolate::decode (row/col idwt_row/idwt_col, /2 truncating rounding via .div2_trunc()).

**Files:** dwt_extrapolate.rs OR dwt.rs — add pub fn decode_simd(&mut [i16], &mut [i16]); diff-test in same file.

**Acceptance Criteria:** decode_simd byte-identical to scalar across zeros/DC/gradients/LCG/edge/negative/overflow; signature matches scalar; scalar decode unchanged.

**Verify:** cargo test -p session --lib idwt_simd_matches_scalar.

```json:metadata
{"files":["third_party/ironrdp/crates/ironrdp-graphics/src/dwt_extrapolate.rs","third_party/ironrdp/crates/ironrdp-graphics/src/dwt.rs"],"verifyCommand":"cd third_party/ironrdp && cargo test -p ironrdp-graphics --lib idwt_simd_matches_scalar","acceptanceCriteria":["decode_simd max|delta|==0 vs scalar over zeros/DC/gradient/random/edge/negative/overflow","signature & buffer contract match scalar decode","scalar decode unchanged"],"modelTier":"complex"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Runtime SIMD toggle + perfAB single-command A/B
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Route reconstruct_to_rgba to decode_simd by default, with a runtime toggle for same-session A/B.

**Files:** progressive.rs (set_simd_idwt + dispatch), session/src/lib.rs (call setter), DesktopSessionTestMulti.tsx (parse ?simd-idwt).

**Acceptance Criteria:** default uses decode_simd; ?simd-idwt=0 forces scalar, =1/absent uses SIMD; toggle on vs off identical RGBA.

**Verify:** cargo test -p session --lib reconstruct_toggle_identical.

```json:metadata
{"files":["third_party/ironrdp/crates/ironrdp-graphics/src/progressive.rs","web/packages/shared/libs/player/crates/session/src/lib.rs","web/packages/shared/libs/player/DesktopSessionTestMulti.tsx"],"verifyCommand":"cd third_party/ironrdp && cargo test -p ironrdp-graphics --lib reconstruct_toggle_identical","acceptanceCriteria":["default decodes via decode_simd","?simd-idwt=0 forces scalar, =1 uses SIMD","toggle on vs off identical RGBA"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Release build + L.perf A/B measurement
tasks.description:
USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.

**Goal:** Measure stages.idwt drop and max full-screen videos @ 45fps, SIMD-off vs SIMD-on, to complete the head-to-head with Lever B.

**Files:** none (measurement).

**Acceptance Criteria:** release wasm built; Gate1 idwt_simd_matches_scalar PASS; Gate2 no black rectangles (visual, SIMD-on); stages.idwt captured for off(baseline) and on(optimized); max videos@45fps recorded both; SIMD-on tiles/s vs Lever B ~236k.

**Verify:** Two L.perf() captures (one per toggle state) with stages.idwt delta + present/inflight at saturation.

